# Pull Request

## Summary
- Describe the change briefly.
- Link related issues (e.g., closes #123).

## Type of change
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] CI/CD

## Checklist
- [ ] Follows Git Flow (branch from `develop`, PR into `develop`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (if applicable)
- [ ] `melos analyze` passes locally
- [ ] `melos test` passes locally
- [ ] Strings localized via `packages/languist`
- [ ] State management uses Redux (not BLoC)

## Screenshots / Recordings
- If UI changes, add screenshots or GIFs

## Additional context
- Notes for reviewers
